metrics.label: Distance
metrics.explanation: Distance from the starting position after ten seconds.

metrics.label: Virtual crossings/s
metrics.explanation: Passages through four virtual flight planes per second. This is a controller readout, not measured walking activity.

metrics.label: Wing motor
metrics.explanation: Wing-motor activity during forward-motion input, relative to the intact calibration.

metrics.label: Looming motor
metrics.explanation: Takeoff-pathway activity evoked by an approaching object. Absolute rates average the TTMn and DLMn populations.

metrics.label: Spared visual
metrics.explanation: Left tangential-cell response to leftward motion. This candidate specificity control is relatively preserved after the site-20 lesion.

rules.label: Original repair
rules.description: Restore selected missing cells with their original identities and connections to available partners.

rules.label: Random wiring
rules.description: Assign the intended cell types, but choose synaptic partners randomly from nearby cells. This differs from selecting missing cells at random.

rules.label: Correct-type graft
rules.description: Assign the intended cell types and take connections from a surviving cell of that type.

rules.label: Non-target graft
rules.description: Use brain cell types absent from the annotated lesion, with the same surviving-cell integration rule as the correct-type graft.
